passages.ending: The entire [Dai–Peng paper](https://doi.org/10.1007/s43034-021-00158-1) was read: harmonic remainders, integral representation, Kelvin identities, the start and continuation of scaling spheres, cone lower bounds, and their bootstrap to the integrability contradiction. The continuation explicitly uses the solution-dependent positive minimum in (3.37) and a continuity step in (3.38), after local L^(n/2) smallness. More fundamentally, both individual Kelvin signs are assumed. At n=5,A=B=0,p=4,q=7/5 the two target gaps equal 1/12, but p exceeds 7/3; its Corollary 1.8 does not cover this target point. Its method therefore cannot simply replace the full-hyperbola half-ball operation by constant extraction.
